description: Run a club, PTA, or association AGM that finishes on time and holds up later — the notice and agenda done right, a quorum plan, minutes that capture decisions not conversations, elections without awkwardness, and the follow-up that makes decisions real. Use when a volunteer says 'I have to run the AGM', 'what goes in the agenda', 'nobody comes to our meetings', or 'our elections are a mess'.
